youtube.title: Why Chili Peppers Burn Your Mouth 🌶️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Chili peppers contain capsaicin, a chemical that activates the TRPV1 receptor on pain-sensing nerves. That same receptor normally detects scalding temperatures above about 43 degrees Celsius. Your brain gets a burn signal even though nothing is hot, so you sweat, your eyes water and your nose runs.
